metadata.description: ClipBlitz Studio's agent plugin: hand an agent a video, get measured vertical clips back, on your own machine.

plugins.name: clipblitz-studio
plugins.description: Cut N clips from a video or URL with ClipBlitz Studio's own stdlib engines, then measure them: risk reports, edit receipts, clearance certificates, a self-training taste model, metadata-only scouting and the ClipBench scoreboard. No cloud, no API key, no upload. Nothing is published unless you ask and the clearance gate is answered.
